summary: Iteration 5 verifies the four changes from this session in the preview: (1) serverless-safe cached db.js (no process.exit) is present in code; live login through /api ensure-DB middleware works (2) 9Wicket lobby thumbnail 404 fix — GET /api/global/client/play-game/11539 returns the new emergentagent-hosted image and the lobby actually renders it (naturalWidth=1024, complete=true); (3) axios timeout 60s->20s in nineWicketService (code inspected, still 20000); (4) CORS allow-list + no-Origin callback still healthy. Regression suites run: 15 pass / 6 fail, and ALL 6 failures explicitly contain 'IP 34.16.56.64 not whitelisted' — environment/provider block only, no code regression. Full UI login + /play-game/11539 launch flow works: exactly ONE POST /api/9wicket/launch, graceful error state (Bengali 'temporarily unavailable / আবার চেষ্টা'), balance restored to 2,000 BDT (visible in header and VIP bar).
critical_code_review_comments: db.js serverless fix looks correct: connection cached on globalThis, no process.exit; index.js app.use('/api') awaits the cached connect and returns 503 JSON on failure — verified indirectly because /api/users/login on this pod (which relies on the same ensure-DB middleware path) returns 200 with a token. Full Vercel verification still gated on Atlas 0.0.0.0/0 allow + redeploy (out of scope for preview).
nineWicketService axios timeout is 20000 at both lines 63 and 79 as specified; provider 'IP not whitelisted' comes back well under that (~1-2s) so timeout change is non-observable but not regressed.

9Wicket thumbnail fix confirmed: DB record image = https://static.prod-images.emergentagent.com/jobs/1de8c2e6-bbc9-4584-b016-849068fec46b/images/38991a80811a2a1a725e05186c4b0a3712272bebdea455d9db4e895d92b96730.jpeg and the loads (imgComplete=true, naturalWidth=1024) — no broken image / alt-text fallback anymore.

CORS: legit preview origin -> access-control-allow-origin echoes the request origin (Cloudflare rewrites to .cluster-5.preview.emergentcf.cloud, still in allow-list). https://evil.example.com -> 500 (Express CORS middleware throws) — rejected. No-Origin POST /api/callback/9wicket returns 200 'OK'.

Graceful launch failure path is solid: PlayGame calls launch exactly once, shows Bengali 'temporarily unavailable' + 'আবার চেষ্টা করুন' style message, does NOT crash, and the demo01 balance is fully restored to 2,000 BDT after the failed launch (no double reservation).
Note: 'Backend root GET /' test item is not testable through the Kubernetes ingress because non-/api paths route to the Vite frontend on :3000. All /api routes work; the change is not a regression.
